question: Rohan deposited ₹500 for 2 years, ₹650 for 4 years and ₹1,300 for 6 years, at the same rate of interest. He received the total simple interest of ₹1,140. What is the rate of interest per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (S.I.) = ₹1140

Principal 1 (P₁) = ₹500, Time (t₁) = 2 years

Principal 2 (P₂) = ₹650, Time (t₂) = 4 years

Principal 3 (P₃) = ₹1300, Time (t₃) = 6 years

**Formula used:**

S.I. = (P × R × T
